description: Verify that TCP in SYN-RCVD / EST / FW1 / FW2 / CW returns to CLOSED on RESET (RFC 793 §3.9 p70). 5 iterations exercise wst ∈ {SYN-RCVD, EST, FW1, FW2, CW}
approach:
[Objective]
A RST in any active state aborts the connection. RFC 793 §3.9 lists this for SYN-RCVD through CW. Verify-probe afterwards elicits a RST proving the socket is gone.

[Scenario — chronological]
5 iterations, one per state. Each: drive DUT to wst, tester sends RST, verify-probe gets RST.

[Pass condition]
All 5 phases close cleanly.

[Fail condition]
Per phase: prelude failure or Fail_p<n>_no_verify_rst.

verdicts.Pass: DUT closed on RST in 5 active states — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_verify_rst: DUT did not emit RST after RST in SYN-RCVD
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 2 EST
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_verify_rst: DUT did not emit RST after RST in EST
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 3 FW1
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_verify_rst: DUT did not emit RST after RST in FW1
verdicts.Fail_p4_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 4 FW2
verdicts.Fail_p4_no_verify_rst: DUT did not emit RST after RST in FW2
verdicts.Fail_p5_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 5 CW
verdicts.Fail_p5_no_close_wait_ack: No DUT close-wait ACK phase 5 CW
verdicts.Fail_p5_no_verify_rst: DUT did not emit RST after RST in CW
